research.name: <shader-doodle />
research.note: Web component that renders a GLSL fragment shader written inline in HTML, with Shadertoy-style uniforms and image, video, webcam and audio inputs.

effects: fragment shader written inline inside an HTML custom element
Shadertoy-compatible uniform mode via a shadertoy attribute
image, video, canvas and webcam sources as shader textures via sd-texture
audio frequency and waveform data as a shader texture via sd-audio
